text: dsh-iphone-mode 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的手机触控界面优化插件。它通过浏览器端模块向页面注入样式，并在视口元标签需要时添加 cover 适配。功能包括触屏输入字号调整、按钮和菜单项的最小触控高度、避免快速点击触发双击缩放、为刘海和底部指示区域留出安全空间，以及窄屏对话框宽度和高度限制。适合使用手机浏览器访问 DSH Web 的用户。代码没有声明 API 密钥、账号或外部服务要求。

dsh-iphone-mode improves mobile use of the DSH Web client. Its browser module injects styles for touch inputs and targets, adds safe-area spacing, and keeps dialogs within narrow screens. It serves people using DSH Web in a phone browser. No API keys, accounts, or external services are declared.
想让手机浏览器里的 DSH 页面更容易触控操作。
在 iPhone 上点输入框时，怎么避免页面自动放大？
让手机上的 DSH 对话框不要超出屏幕边缘。
dsh-iphone-mode 的功能「手机触控布局」：在触屏设备上放大输入文字和按钮等触控目标，并限制窄屏对话框的尺寸。页面加载应用样式，无需额外操作。
dsh-iphone-mode README · dsh-iphone-mode：Mobile/touch optimizations for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI — makes the harness genuinely usable from a phone browser (e.g. over Tailscale).

dsh-iphone-mode README · What it fixes：| Problem on iPhone | Fix |
|---|---|
| iOS Safari **zooms into any input under 16px** on focus (composer, search boxes) and the layout never recovers | `font-size: 16px` on all inputs under `@media (pointer: coarse)` — desktop untouched |
| Content hidden under the **notch / home indicator** | `viewport-fit=cover` + `env(safe-area-inset-*)` body padding (portrait bottom, landscape sides) |
| Tiny touch targets | gentle 36px minimums on buttons/options under coarse pointers |
| Stock GUI **dialogs render off-viewport** at desktop width on a phone (Commands palette "doesn't work" — it opens, you just can't see it; menus clip both edges) | viewport clamp: every `[class*="_dialog_"]` capped to `calc(100vw - 24px)` on narrow screens, with 16px inputs inside them too |
dsh-iphone-mode README · What it fixes：Pure client-side plugin: injects one `<style>` tag and ensures the viewport meta allows cover fitting. No server-side work.

dsh-iphone-mode README · Install：```sh
cd /path/to/your-dsh-profile   # e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add github:johndfowler/dsh-iphone-mode
